_about: Rules for the airport pages (read by tools/site/lib/airportdata.mjs). thinBelow: an airport page with fewer substantive facts (city, IATA code, scheduled routes, ACI rank, two or more runways, map detail beyond the runways) is noindex,follow: it still links and is still built. countryMinIndexed: a country hub with fewer mapped airports is noindex,follow.
